rules.title: OpenSSH version disclosed
rules.description: SSH banner exposes OpenSSH version; review against current advisories.
rules.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to a currently supported release and disable unused algorithms.

rules.title: Outdated OpenSSH (major < 8)
rules.description: OpenSSH major version below 8 may lack modern security fixes.

rules.title: Apache HTTP Server version disclosed
rules.description: Apache version visible in banner or Server header.
rules.remediation: Upgrade Apache and suppress version tokens (ServerTokens Prod).

rules.title: nginx version disclosed
rules.description: nginx version exposed; confirm patch level.
rules.remediation: Upgrade nginx and set server_tokens off.

rules.title: MySQL version disclosed
rules.remediation: Upgrade MySQL/MariaDB and restrict network exposure.

rules.title: Potentially Heartbleed-era OpenSSL
rules.description: Banner suggests OpenSSL 1.0.1 which was affected by Heartbleed and related issues.
rules.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSL immediately; rotate keys/certs if historically exposed.

rules.title: Dropbear SSH version disclosed
rules.remediation: Keep Dropbear updated; prefer key-only auth.

rules.title: vsftpd version disclosed
rules.remediation: Prefer SFTP/SSH; upgrade vsftpd if FTP must remain.
